intro.text: The Lord Artisan of Lossand, Taisha of the Draft, elected by the artisans to lead the country's manufacturing.

items.text: Rite was mainly angry about the Diem's unpaid debts and worried about future theft. Khriss proposed that sand masters work for the artisans for a share of the profits in return for his vote, with the Diem first settling what it owed the Draft.
He had voted to dissolve the Diem at first, but once Kenton, with a loan from the Guild, repaid the Diem's debt, Rite voted to keep it.
